name: get_item
description: Reads the item. Returns: Text, quoted text, source, author, times.

name: search_tank_items
description: Full-text search over everything collected (≤ 90 days, ≤ 20 hits). Returns: Hits with item ids.

name: list_open_events
description: Reads open events. Returns: Statements, stages, known_to_us_at, sessions.

name: get_event
description: Reads the event. Returns: Claims, quotes, stages, sources, assessment.

name: get_registry
description: Registry and dependency map. Returns: Identity, aliases, official accounts and sources.

name: get_token_facts
description: Stored fundamentals. Returns: Fees and revenue, supply and unlocks, venues and markets.

name: web_search
description: DuckDuckGo text search through the ddgs library (02 §9): 10 results, DuckDuckGo only; results stored as evidence. Returns: Titles, URLs and snippets.

name: fetch_page
description: HTTPS GET (20 s, ≤ 2 MB); page stored as evidence. Returns: Readable text.

name: record_event
description: Validators below; writes the event, its ORIGIN observation and the claims. Returns: event_id; accepted and dropped claims with reasons.

name: add_observation
description: Same validators; state machine §3.6. Returns: New stage, contradictions.

name: merge_into
description: Merges this session's event into an earlier open event (§3.3). Returns: The surviving event.

name: set_assessment
description: Checks §4.3–4.6; a MAJOR+ final class escalates the official sources of the event's organizations to 15 s for 2 h (§9) and opens the reaction record (§8). Returns: Final class, with any cap applied.

name: set_beneficiaries
description: Rules of §4.7. Returns: Analysis set (universe tokens) and per-layer reasons for none.

name: get_market_truth
description: ESCALATE_TOKENS, backfill, RUN_MARKET_TRUTH (§5). Returns: Market Truth and Data Confidence per token.

name: get_decision
description: Outlook (§6), grades (§4.8–4.9), action (§7.1–7.2), conditions (§6.6). Returns: Action, grades, outlook, conditions, decisive facts.

name: publish_card
description: Alert gate and update policy (§7.4), linter (§7.5), template, evidence bundle, DELIVER job. Returns: Alert id and version, or the refusal with reasons.
